sections.text: مقدمة

This 
document details the major maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed on an annually 
bases or at any troubles occurs as indicated
by Y1 in the title block.

Function of the pump: سحب المازوت من خلال السخان وضخه إلى أعلى الخزان اليومي.

quality control eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil, approved by eng. Mokhter Abd El Latif

& quality 
control head sector.

Remove inlet head
قم بإزالة مسامير الغطاء (4) واسحب رأس المدخل (24)
Remove Idler rotors

Remove Bolts (21) Remove thrust plate (9) and spacers 
(20)Remove Idler balance piston housing (18) roll out Idler rotors (17)
Remove in board cover

Remove Bolts (4) with draw the in board cover (9) and O-ring 
(7) from the case (1).
Remove Power rotor assembly

Remove Bolts (16), bearing retainer (26), bearing (14), 
bearing retainer (26), bearing spacer (13) and mechanical seal (23).
Remove rotor housing

Push the rotor housing (2) and O ring (6) out of inlet end 
of the case (1)
